end.parentNote: Harsh practised identifying quadrants from the signs of x and y, and explaining that the first coordinate shows horizontal movement while the second shows vertical movement. They correctly answered examples for Quadrants II and IV and explained why (3,2) and (2,3) are different points. There was a mix-up while identifying a plotted point, which was corrected later by writing (4, 3). At home, ask Harsh to plot a few ordered pairs and name their quadrants, saying “horizontal first, vertical second” each time.
